cd /app/tmp/fz && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, sys, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp/fz')
from rp2 import Sim
random.seed(12)
P,R,D = 8,128,32
inp=[[[(r+q) if i==0 else (i%3) for i in range(D)] for q in range(R)] for r in range(P)]
slotsn,window=16,8
s=Sim(P,R,D,inp,slotsn,window)
events=[]
while len(events)<19800:
    opts=[]
    pend=s.pending()
    for _ in range(14):
        if pend: opts.append(["deliver",random.choice(pend)])
    for r in range(P):
        hi=min(R, s.sent[r]+s.window)
        if s.sent[r]<hi:
            opts.append(["send",r,random.randrange(s.sent[r],hi)])
    for r in range(P):
        opts.append(["retry",r])
    try:
        ev=random.choice(opts)
        events.append(ev); s.tick(ev)
    except (RuntimeError, IndexError):
        events.pop(); break
req={"op":"replay","inputs":inp,"slots":slotsn,"window":window,"events":events}
open('/app/tmp/t/big12.jsonl','w').write(json.dumps(req)+"\n")
sys.stderr.write("events=%d created=%d pend=%d\n"%(len(events),s.created,len(s.pend)))
EOF
wc -c /app/tmp/t/big12.jsonl; time (python3 -I /app/submission/main.py < /app/tmp/t/big12.jsonl > /app/tmp/t/o12.json); wc -c /app/tmp/t/o12.json
